question: What flat late-time LCDM, constant-w and CPL distance-modulus profiles fit the pinned DES-Dovekie Hubble diagram under its full released STAT+SYS precision?
hypothesis: A native-format independent parser and profiled-magnitude likelihood can reproduce bounded release-data profile points without adding diagonal errors or treating the SN normalization as H0.
assumptions_and_units: Use flat late-time matter plus dark energy; radiation/curvature omitted at z<=1.145.
zHD enters the expansion integral and zHEL enters the luminosity-distance prefactor, matching the release likelihood convention.
H0 gauge is 70 km/s/Mpc but analytically absorbed by the profiled magnitude offset; H0 not inferred.
c=299792.458 km/s; distances in Mpc; magnitude residuals in mag.

model_parameters_and_priors.interpretation: bounded profile search domains, not priors

nuisance_parameters.additive_magnitude_offset: one analytically profiled common offset per model; complete Gaussian normalization terms are parameter-independent and omitted from profile minima

training_validation_holdout_definition: No split or holdout; all 1,820 rows retained under the official zHD>0 selection.
covariance_order_and_overlap_treatment: Rows preserved in official Hubble-diagram order. Full 1,820x1,820 packed STAT+SYS inverse covariance reconstructed; no MUERR is added again. This SN release is analyzed alone, not multiplied by original DES-SN5YR, Pantheon+ or Union3.
command: OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 .venv/bin/python work/inference/fit_dovekie.py --starts 12; OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 .venv/bin/python work/inference/check_cpl_boundary.py
metric_definition: Minimum residual^T W residual after analytic profile of a single magnitude offset; W is the full released STAT+SYS precision.
uncertainty: No posterior, evidence, confidence interval or significance was computed. CPL best fit depends on the allowed wa range.
interpretation_and_limits: Independent reproduction of a profile-only release-data calculation. The official pinned module's CSV reader is inconsistent with the native SNANA whitespace input; our parser follows pinned release semantics but does not execute CosmoSIS or reproduce its published posterior. CPL improvement is modest and strongly domain-sensitive; no evolving-DE evidence claim follows.
independent_reviewer: Luna Max critic used a separately written parser, distance evaluator, full covariance profile algebra and seeded differential-evolution search.
review_disposition: Independent fixed-point and bounded-minimum reproductions agree; limitation is likelihood-reader mismatch and profile-only interpretation, not unresolved algebra.
next_test: Radiation-sensitivity lane is evaluating the higher-redshift BAO approximation; if continuing SN work, first evaluate selection/calibration nuisance sensitivity rather than combining overlapping SN branches.
